english.title: Young person enter premises where adult gaming centre premises licence has effect - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a young person aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..), entered premises where an adult gaming centre premises licence had effect in respect of the premises and the premises were being used in reliance on that licence when you entered
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 49, 47(5) and 62(2)(b) of the Gambling Act 2005.
